**Finding submitted: INSURANCE — missing (fallback insert).**

- **Investigation:** Full-document searches for "insurance" and "coverage/policy/insurer/certificate" returned nothing. I read the indemnity article (§12, p0070–p0077, including the liability cap) and all miscellaneous provisions through §30, plus §8 Client covenants and §9 TrueLink warranties — no insurance obligation on either party.
- **Direction:** The gap runs against us: TrueLink hosts our web site and is licensed to use, store and process Client Content and Credit Data (§8d), and its liability is capped at 12 months' hosting/support fees, so there is no backstop.
- **Target level:** Fallback (E&O USD 1M; cyber/privacy USD 2M) — the shortest complete cure. I did not add CGL, workers' compensation, certificates, term/tail or at-own-expense language, as those sit only at the preferred level and are outside the selected checklist.
- **Edit:** New Section 31 inserted after §30 Force Majeure (p0097), before the signature block; both fallback elements mapped to that single operation. Redline validated `ok:true` with minimality passing.
